{{Top|leg}}
A '''karfler''' was a creature.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],</ref> on a [[Unidentified planetoid (The Redoubt)|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|starcluster]], a group of [[Vagaari Empire]] operatives [[Expedition to Outbound Flight|infiltrated]] the wreckage of the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' and released several [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Diet/Legends|predators]] known as [[wolvkil]]s, one of which shook itself like a [[Water/Legends|wet]] karfler.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The karfler was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''.<ref name="SQ" />
